name: Can I install a garbage disposal with any kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a garbage disposal with any kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most modern kitchen sinks are compatible with garbage disposals, but there are some considerations. You'll need a sink with a suitable drain opening, typically 3.5 inches in diameter, and sufficient under-sink space for the unit. If your current sink drain is smaller, a replacement might be necessary. Also, ensure there is an accessible electrical outlet under the sink for power. Frasheski Construction can assess your existing setup to confirm compatibility or recommend necessary modifications during your kitchen remodel in the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: While most sinks are compatible, ensure your kitchen sink has a 3.5-inch drain opening and enough under-sink space, plus an accessible electrical outlet, for garbage disposal installation.
